annotations.title: Send a test event to a webhook

description: Sends a synthetic `webhook.test` event to a webhook endpoint, signed like a real delivery, and returns whether it answered with a 2xx (`ok`), its HTTP status (null when it could not be reached) and the start of its answer. The attempt is listed among the endpoint's deliveries.
name: mails_webhooks_test
title: Send a test event to a webhook
